PM Modi visits Indonesian temple, receives civilian honor

Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the 1,000-year-old Prambanan Temple in Indonesia and offered prayers. He was accompanied by Indonesian President Joko Widodo during the visit to the Hindu temple. Modi also received Indonesia's top civilian honor. He later met with Indonesian President Prabowo to strengthen ties and subsequently traveled to Australia. Separately, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath offered prayers at the Maa Vindhyavasini Temple in Mirzapur.
